## What changed

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check src tests`

Tested on:

- [ ] Windows x64
- [ ] macOS Intel
- [ ] macOS Apple Silicon
- [ ] Other / not platform-specific

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and based on the latest `main` branch.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior where practical.
- [ ] User documentation is updated when the interface or workflow changes.
- [ ] No personal photographs, catalog data, credentials, or generated builds are included.
- [ ] Any new bundled model or third-party asset has its source, license, and checksum documented.
